By creating an account, joining a waitlist, applying for access, or using ASND, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use ASND.

ASND is a vetted network designed to help creators, brands, and agencies discover and connect with relevant creative collaborators. ASND may provide tools for creating professional profiles; discovering creators, brands, and agencies; posting and responding to opportunities; connecting with relevant collaborators; and communicating after a connection is made. ASND is a discovery and connection service. Agencies on ASND are participants. An agency may have its own profile, find collaborators for its own work, and be found by other users. Agencies do not act as intermediaries and do not broker connections between other users through ASND. Unless expressly stated otherwise, ASND does not act as an employer, staffing agency, talent agency, representative, broker, payment provider, or party to agreements entered into between users.

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or use ASND. By using ASND, you confirm that you are legally able to enter into these Terms, the information you provide is accurate, and you are not prohibited from using the service under applicable law. If you use ASND on behalf of a business, agency, or organization, you confirm that you have authority to act on its behalf.

ASND currently supports three primary account types: CreatorsIndividuals offering creative skills, services, or work. BrandsBusinesses or organizations seeking creative collaborators.AgenciesBusinesses or organizations offering creative services or representing talent, who use ASND as participants to find collaborators for their own work and to be found by others. ASND may limit users to one primary role per account. Agency accountsEach agency has one agency account. Individual people who work at an agency may hold their own ASND accounts as creators or brand-side users, and may be linked to the agency's profile. An agency may link its profile to a creator only if that creator holds their own ASND profile and has agreed to the link. An agency profile may not list creators who are not ASND members.

Certain users, particularly creators and agencies, may be required to complete an application before receiving full access. Creator applications may include identity and contact information, portfolio or website links, social media links, previous clients or collaborations, work samples, and references or people who can vouch for the applicant. Creator vetting is conducted through human review. ASND does not represent that artificial intelligence independently evaluates or approves creative work. Agency verificationAgencies are also reviewed by people before receiving full access. Agency applications may include agency name, website, and work email; portfolio or past work; previous clients or collaborations; the creators and brands the agency works with; and at least one client or creator who can confirm the relationship with the agency. Agency verification is conducted through human review, and ASND does not represent that artificial intelligence independently approves agencies. A reference or vouch does not guarantee acceptance. ASND may accept, hold, request additional information from, or decline to activate an applicant based on the needs and standards of the network. Admission to ASND does not guarantee work, income, responses, opportunities, or future collaboration.

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for activity through your account. You agree to provide accurate information, keep your information reasonably current, maintain control of your login credentials, and notify ASND if you believe your account has been accessed without permission. You may not sell, transfer, rent, or share your account without permission.
Certain profile information may be visible to other ASND users

Depending on your account type, this may include name; profile image; location; discipline; niche or specialty; portfolio; work samples; availability; previous collaborations; brand or client associations; agency affiliation, and links to creators who hold their own ASND profiles; and professional information. You are responsible for ensuring that you have permission to upload or display any content, images, logos, work samples, or other materials you provide.

Brands, agencies, and eligible creators may be able to post opportunities or briefs. Agencies post opportunities and briefs for their own work. If an agency posts a brief on behalf of a client, the brief must name the client or clearly state that it is posted on behalf of a client. Briefs may include deliverables; compensation; deadlines; usage rights; project details; eligibility requirements; confidentiality requirements; and the client on whose behalf the brief is posted, if any. The person or organization posting the opportunity is responsible for the accuracy and legality of the information provided. ASND does not guarantee that a brief will receive responses, a creator will be selected, a project will proceed, compensation will be paid, deliverables will be accepted, and either party will complete an agreement. Users are responsible for evaluating opportunities and collaborators before entering into any arrangement.

Some opportunities may be marked private or may require acceptance of confidentiality terms before full details are visible. If you accept confidentiality obligations, you are responsible for complying with them. ASND may provide tools that facilitate acceptance of confidentiality terms but is not responsible for enforcing agreements between users unless ASND is expressly a party to that agreement.

When users connect through ASND, the service may provide a messaging channel. You may not use messaging to harass or threaten another person, send spam, impersonate another person, distribute malicious software, solicit unlawful activity, share content you do not have permission to distribute, and attempt to bypass platform security. ASND may investigate reported misuse and restrict access when appropriate.

Users are responsible for their own negotiations and agreements. This may include compensation, deliverables, deadlines, intellectual property, content usage, licensing, exclusivity, confidentiality, cancellations, revisions, taxes, and expenses. ASND is not responsible for resolving commercial disputes between users unless we expressly agree otherwise.

Agreements between an agency and its clients, creators, or staff are separate from ASND and are the responsibility of those parties. ASND does not guarantee the identity, conduct, reliability, financial condition, quality, or legal compliance of any user simply because that user is present on the network. Vetting is intended to improve trust and relevance, not eliminate risk.

Using ASND does not create an employment relationship between ASND and any creator, brand, agency, or other user. Nothing in these Terms creates a partnership, joint venture, fiduciary relationship, franchise, employment relationship, or agency relationship between ASND and a user.

ASND may introduce paid subscriptions or other paid features. Any pricing, billing frequency, renewal terms, cancellation rights, and taxes will be disclosed before purchase. ASND does not charge users per application or per opportunity unless these Terms and the applicable pricing are updated and clearly disclosed. ASND may offer free, beta, promotional, or founding access. Such access may later change or end, subject to any commitments expressly made to users.

ASND may offer referral programs. Where a referral reward is offered, eligibility may depend on the referred applicant successfully completing the vetting process. Submitting a name alone does not automatically create a right to payment. Specific referral terms will be provided when a referral program is active.

You retain ownership of content you upload to ASND. By uploading content, you grant ASND a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, store, reproduce, display, resize, format, and otherwise use that content only as reasonably necessary to operate, improve, secure, and present the service. This license ends when the content is removed, except where continued storage is reasonably necessary for backups, legal obligations, security, or dispute handling. You confirm that you have the rights necessary to upload your content.

ASND's software, branding, interfaces, text, graphics, logos, designs, and other materials created by or for ASND are owned by Aryan Irani, ASND, or applicable licensors. You may not copy, reproduce, reverse engineer, distribute, sell, or commercially exploit ASND materials except where permitted by law or with written permission.

You may not provide deliberately false information; impersonate another person or company; create fraudulent profiles; scrape or systematically extract ASND data; use automated tools to collect member information without permission; interfere with platform security or operation; upload unlawful or infringing content; harass other users; use ASND for fraud or illegal activity; manipulate references, reviews, or vetting; attempt to gain unauthorized access to another account; resell access to ASND data or profiles without permission; link an agency profile to a creator without that creator's agreement; and post a brief on behalf of a client without the disclosure required by these Terms. ASND may allow users to report non-response, no-shows, or similar reliability issues following a connection. Reports are informational signals and do not constitute legal findings. ASND may review, disregard, retain, or act on reports at its discretion. ASND does not guarantee that another user will respond, attend a meeting, perform work, or fulfill an agreement.

Certain ASND features may operate as beta or early-access services. Beta features may contain errors, change frequently, be unavailable temporarily, have limited activity or functionality, and be discontinued. Participation in beta access does not guarantee continued access to any particular feature. Feedback provided by beta users may be used to improve ASND.

ASND may contain links to third-party websites, portfolios, social media services, payment providers, cloud services, or other platforms. ASND does not control those services and is not responsible for their content, availability, privacy practices, security, or terms. Your use of third-party services is governed by their own terms.

Deactivation may hide the profile from discovery, stop certain notifications, and prevent normal use of the platform. ASND is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis to the maximum extent permitted by law. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot legally be waived.

This includes loss resulting from unsuccessful collaborations, lost opportunities, user conduct, payment disputes, intellectual property disputes, content usage disputes, service interruptions, and unauthorized account access outside ASND's reasonable control. h2: 9. Sale and sharing of personal information
p: This Privacy Policy explains how ASND collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal information when you use the service. ASND is currently an unincorporated project operated by Aryan Irani. This Privacy Policy applies to ASND's website, applications, waitlists, applications, profiles, discovery tools, messaging, beta programs, and related services.

The information we collect depends on how you use ASND.Information you provide directlyWe may collect name; email address; phone number; location; account role; login information; profile photograph; professional information; skills, disciplines, niches, and specialties; availability; payment preferences; portfolio and website links; social media links; work samples; past clients and collaborations; brand or agency information; application answers; brief and opportunity information; messages sent through ASND; and feedback and support requests.

Creator applications may include portfolio information, professional history, previous clients, work samples, references or vouches, and contact information for people who may be able to vouch for the applicant.Creator applications are reviewed by people.ASND does not use artificial intelligence as the final decision-maker for creator vetting.

If an applicant provides another person's name, email address, or phone number as a possible reference or vouch, we may use that information to determine whether that person is already part of ASND, contact them to confirm whether they know the applicant, and support the applicant's vetting process. Users should only provide reference information where they reasonably believe the person would expect to be contacted for this purpose.

We may collect company or agency name, work email, website, social media or other verifying links, industry or specialty, campaign history, creative needs, briefs, links to creators who hold their own ASND profiles and have agreed to the link, past work, and clients on whose behalf briefs are posted. Agency applications are reviewed by people. ASND does not use artificial intelligence as the final decision-maker for agency verification. If an agency provides the name, email address, or phone number of a client or creator who can confirm the relationship, we may use it as described in Section 3 (Reference information). ASND does not collect or display roster information about creators who do not have their own ASND profile.

When you use ASND, we may automatically collect information such as IP address, device type, browser, operating system, pages or screens viewed, interactions with features, referring pages, approximate location derived from IP address, dates and times of use, and error and diagnostic information. We may use cookies, local storage, or similar technologies for these purposes.

We may use personal information to create and manage accounts, process applications, conduct human vetting, verify users, operate profiles and discovery, provide search and filtering, recommend potentially relevant profiles or opportunities, enable briefs and responses, facilitate connections, provide messaging, communicate service updates, provide customer support, detect fraud and misuse, enforce ASND's Terms, maintain security, understand how ASND is used, improve user experience, test new features, and comply with legal obligations. ASND may use automated tools or artificial intelligence to assist with search, filtering, classification, ranking, or product operations. ASND does not use AI to independently decide whether a creator passes human vetting.

Some information is intended to be visible to other eligible ASND users. This may include name, photograph, discipline, niche, location, availability, work samples, portfolio, professional history, past collaborations, associated brands, agency information, links between agencies and creators who hold their own ASND profiles, and clients named on briefs. We will not intentionally display private contact details publicly unless the feature clearly indicates that the information will be visible

With other ASND usersInformation may be shared when necessary for profile discovery, brief responses, references, connections, messaging, and collaboration. With service providersWe may use third-party providers for cloud hosting, databases, authentication, email, analytics, security, customer support, payments, artificial intelligence services, and infrastructure. These providers may process information on our behalf only as needed to provide their services. For legal and safety reasons We may disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to lawful requests, protect users, investigate fraud or abuse, enforce our agreements, and protect ASND's rights or property. Business transfersIf ASND later becomes part of a company, investment, acquisition, merger, restructuring, or asset transfer, information may be transferred as part of that transaction where permitted by law.

ASND does not sell personal information for money. ASND does not intend to sell user profiles, contact information, application information, or portfolio data to data brokers. Some privacy laws define "sale" or "sharing" more broadly, particularly where advertising technologies are involved. If ASND later uses technologies that legally constitute sale or sharing, we will provide any notices and opt-out mechanisms required by law.

ASND may use cookies and similar technologies to keep users signed in, remember preferences, maintain security, understand platform use, diagnose errors, and measure performance. Where required by law, ASND will request consent before using non-essential cookies. Users may also control cookies through their browser settings.

ASND may process profile and opportunity information to help users identify relevant collaborators. Factors may include discipline, niche, style, availability, location, industry experience, preferred collaboration type, and past collaborations. These tools support discovery. They do not guarantee suitability, employment, performance, or successful collaboration.

Creator vetting is conducted through human review. Agency verification is also conducted through human review. Different creative categories may require different forms of evaluation. Information used for vetting may include portfolio materials, work samples, professional history, verifying information, and references or vouches. Automated systems may support administrative tasks but do not make the final creative-quality decision.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy. This may include providing the service, maintaining accounts, resolving disputes, preventing fraud, maintaining security, and complying with legal obligations.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information. Deactivating an account may hide the profile and stop normal use without immediately deleting all associated information. Limited records may be retained after deactivation where reasonably necessary for legal compliance, security, fraud prevention, or recordkeeping.

ASND uses reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information. No digital system can guarantee absolute security. Users are responsible for protecting their login credentials and should notify ASND if they believe their account has been compromised.

Depending on where you live and which laws apply, you may have rights concerning your personal information. These may include the right to request access to personal information, request correction of inaccurate information, request deletion, withdraw consent where processing relies on consent, object to or restrict certain processing, receive information about how your data is used, opt out of certain sale or sharing practices, appeal certain privacy decisions, and complain to an appropriate regulator. Not every right applies in every jurisdiction. We may need to verify your identity before completing a request. To submit a privacy request, contact: ai3926@rit.edu

ASND is operated from New York. Where New York law applies to ASND and your information, including laws on data security and breach notification, ASND will handle your personal information in accordance with those laws. New York residents may contact ASND using the details in Section 24 with questions or requests about their personal information, and ASND will respond as required by applicable law. ASND does not currently intend to sell personal information.

ASND may process personal data relating to users in India. Where Indian privacy law applies to ASND, we will process personal data in accordance with applicable legal requirements. This may include providing notice about what personal data is collected, why it is collected, how it is used, how users may exercise applicable rights, and how users may contact ASND regarding privacy concerns.Where consent is required, users may withdraw consent subject to applicable law and legitimate retention obligations.

ASND may serve users in multiple countries. Information may therefore be processed or stored outside the country where a user lives. Where required by law, ASND will use appropriate safeguards for international data transfers.

ASND is intended for people aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 through normal account registration. If we learn that information was collected from a child in violation of applicable law, we will take reasonable steps to delete it.

ASND profiles may contain links to websites, portfolios, social media platforms, and external services. ASND is not responsible for the privacy practices of those third parties. Users should review external privacy policies before providing information to those services.

We may send service-related communications such as account notifications, application updates, opportunity notifications, security notices, and platform updates. Where permitted, we may also send marketing communications. Users can unsubscribe from promotional communications using the method provided in those messages. Certain account and security communications may still be required while an account remains active.

Where available, users may deactivate their ASND account. Deactivation may remove the profile from normal discovery, stop certain notifications, and prevent normal account activity. Deactivation is not necessarily the same as permanent deletion. Users may contact ASND to request deletion where applicable law provides that right.

We may update this Privacy Policy as ASND evolves or legal requirements change. The effective date will be updated when changes are made.If changes materially affect how personal information is used, we will provide additional notice where required by law.
Questions, concerns, or privacy requests may be sent to: ASNDOperated by Aryan Irani Rochester, New York, United States Privacy email: ai3926@rit.edu General contact: ai3926@rit.edu

A UGC (User-Generated Content) video agency is a specialized marketing firm that bridges the gap between brands and content creators to produce authentic, high-quality, and authentic-looking video content.
How is UGC different from traditional ads?

UGC feels more authentic and relatable because it’s created by real users, while traditional ads are brand-produced, polished, and sales-focused. UGC builds trust faster through genuine experiences and social proof.
How long does it take to deliver videos?

Most videos are delivered within 3–7 business days, depending on the project scope, revisions, and content style. Rush delivery options are often available for urgent campaigns or quick social media content.
Do you provide full script writing?
Yes, we provide complete script writing tailored to your brand, audience, and campaign goals — including hooks, talking points, captions, and clear call-to-actions for engaging video content.
How do I get started my UGC brand?
Start by defining your niche, target audience, and content style. Then create sample videos, build a strong social presence, and collaborate with brands to grow your portfolio and credibility.
